## Standing operator rules
Any new secret reference in config/secrets.yaml must use vault://ledgerly/<ENV>/<KEY> and never an environment-variable placeholder.

Never enable a new Celery task in ledgerly/tasks/ unless perf/locust_tasks.py demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix double-counted refunds in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. The Tenacity replacement is paused and superseded until next sprint.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Sandbox payments API: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`
- `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is superseded and shut down.
- Deployment image: `registry.example.com/payments/webhook:v2.8.1`
- Replay image: `registry.example.com/payments/replay:1.4.0`
- Worker/consumer: `ledgerly/workers/billing_worker.py`, `ledgerly/workers/usage_consumer.py`
- CLI: `ledgerly/cli.py`
- Remaining lint issues: E501 at `ledgerly/cli.py:117` and `:203`.

## Plan and progress
- Billing retention and CLI refactor: done; full suite previously passed, targeted CLI tests now pass.
- Reconciliation refund fix: pending; exact next command has not been specified.
- Cutover: health and steps 3–4 done; replay job created.
- Next pending replay command: `kubectl -n payments logs job/webhook-replay-a`
- Temporary debugger-breakpoint removal: status unknown.

## Recent work
Billing worker no longer retains `_last_batch`; retention and isolation tests pass. CLI billing filters were shared and deduplicated; 37 targeted tests pass. Cutover deployment/service changes and replay job creation succeeded. Last observed lint reported two long help-string lines. Refund investigation has not begun.
